AIF_scope: operational expected decision-regret reduction plus normalized information gain; not full generative AIF
changing_preferences: only change condition; no answer noise there; reversal after fourth answer, hidden from inference
common_random_numbers: potential answer noise fixed by seed/user/question/pair; menus and true trajectories common across arms/filters
primary_endpoint: transfer normalized regret at8questions; paired AIF-minus-decision_focused and AIF-minus-EIG in every condition/filter
intervals: 95% percentile resampling across24preference-order clusters, seed repetitions averaged within cluster; exploratory finite-order uncertainty, not human population inference
qualification: synthetic finite preference discovery only; exact executor, no LLM/tool assimilation/RL training
